parsed.explanation: Tier-1 state-imposed universal exposures dominate: the 2025 passport policy (sex at birth, X markers stopped, reports of confiscated passports stranding travellers), the visa cable directing refusal of discrepant documents with potential lifetime fraud bars, and facility bans in ~20 states (4 criminal, one documented trespass arrest). Documented custody abuses (immigration detention forced labour, sexual abuse; corrections policy stripping hormones) add severity. However: much of the country imposes no ban, courts have enjoined several orders, hate-crime and employment protections operate, same-sex marriage stands, no documented killing rate, and no fraud ground yet applied in practice. Substantial but uneven state hostility with partial working recourse places this mid-band, materially below tolerant jurisdictions, above criminalising ones.
